iWant: the package to carry only the tool, not rcf-lite's own requirements chain
soThat: reviewer names, verdicts and the rulings ledger of the tool's own development never land in my node_modules
description: Privacy: rcf/ leaves the npm files (contract C1, ruling R3).
title: An adopter installs rcf-lite from npm and receives none of rcf-lite's own chain

acceptanceCriteria.description: [must-not] Given packages/rcf-lite at the reviewed head, when `npm pack --dry-run --json` runs in packages/rcf-lite (the real npm pack, its prepack included), then it exits 0 and the file list it prints holds no file whose path starts with `rcf/`.

[happy] Given the tarball `npm pack` produces in packages/rcf-lite, installed with `npm install ` into a fresh empty directory, when the installed package's bin runs, in that directory, `rcf init`, `rcf doctor`, `rcf guidance build-cycle`, the MCP server (`rcf mcp`) answering `resources/list`, and `rcf audit view --port

` (then stopped with SIGTERM sent to its own pid), then each exits 0, the installed package holds no `rcf/` folder, and no command reads, stats or lists any path under the installed package's `rcf/`. External: the 0.41.0 release Verify also runs this journey.
